title: Could Samson really bring down a temple?

beats.text: Could one man really topple a temple?
beats.scene: Painted blinded giant between two huge wooden pillars in a Philistine temple, dusk light. Overlay: none.

beats.text: Judges says three thousand people sat on the roof.
beats.scene: Crowd packed on a flat temple roof at sunset. Overlay: counter 3,000.

beats.text: Samson, blind and chained, stands between two central pillars.
beats.scene: Chained man feeling two pillars with his hands. Overlay: none.

beats.text: Stretch your arms wide. That is about the gap.
beats.scene: Close-up of outstretched arms between two pillars. Overlay: scale bar about 2 m.

beats.text: At Tell Qasile, archaeologist Amihai Mazar found a Philistine temple.
beats.scene: Archaeologists brushing stone ruins in morning light. Overlay: none.

beats.text: Its roof rested on two central wooden pillars.
beats.scene: Reconstruction of temple interior with two timber columns. Overlay: none.

beats.text: They stood on stone bases about two metres apart.
beats.scene: Two round stone bases in dusty ground. Overlay: scale bar 2 m.

beats.text: Push those apart, and the roof beams could drop.
beats.scene: Roof beams cracking, dust falling, wide shot. Overlay: none.

beats.text: The people on top fall with it.
beats.scene: Crowd tumbling in a cloud of dust at sunset. Overlay: counter 3,000.

beats.text: Not proven: that site is not Gaza, so it only shows the design.
beats.scene: Map-less painted coastline of ancient Philistia at dusk. Overlay: question mark badge.

beats.text: The design is real; the story is the question.
beats.scene: Temple pillars at dawn, camera pulling back. Overlay: none.

beats.text: So could Samson topple a temple? Legend, or memory?
beats.scene: Silhouette between two pillars, backlit by sunset. Overlay: choice tags A legend / B memory.

youtube.title: Could Samson Really Topple a Temple? #shorts
youtube.description:
Judges 16 says Samson pushed two pillars and a temple fell. Archaeologists have found Philistine temples built exactly this way.
That does not prove the story.
#Samson #Bible #Philistines #BibleHistory
